title: Realizing Non-Archimedean Polish Groups as Outer Automorphism Groups
summary: We prove that every non-Archimedean Polish group is topologically isomorphic to the outer automorphism group of a countable discrete group. Furthermore, our construction is Borel. This implies that determining whether two countable discrete groups have topologically isomorphic outer automorphism groups is at least as complicated as classifying non-Archimedean Polish groups up to topological isomorphism, and so in particular not classifiable by countable structures. Our construction is based on the theory of right-angled Coxeter groups. Along the way, we prove results of independent interest…
